fixes.explanation: Not quite, friend. Abraham doesn't wave them off. After he bows, he asks them to speak to Ephron, son of Zohar, for him, because the cave of Machpelah belongs to Ephron (Genesis 23:8-9). This is the same man who had just asked them for a burial site (Genesis 23:4). I think he's glad to have their help, and he asks for it politely.
